_readme: Single source of truth for sponsor prices, shared by the site and the payments Worker (the Worker charges exactly these amounts). price is in rupees, set by position (home page highest). exclusive: one advertiser at a time (pandal-nearby is exclusive per pandal instead). maxPandals: how many pandal cards one 'pandal-nearby' booking covers. tbd: shows a 'TBD' marker next to prices.
